deviations_from_card: Revision applied: stageAll takes 'keep' only (keeps every open forget offer, never a contradiction); no bulk forget; each row's Keep/Forget/Forget-this-one is staged behind its own 6 s window. Section case 8 therefore reads 'Keeping 3 · Undo' for the bulk batch and 'Forgetting 1 · Undo' for a row forget. Added a 9th case (row presses and Keep all stage). decide() removed from the store (replaced by stage/stageAll/undo/commitNow); its two existing tests now go through stage + commitNow. Write set grew by one coupled line in scenes/mind/fixtures.ts (the SleepModel actions fixture) plus ADR 0219. StagedBatch carries `at` (staged-at on the store clock) so the Undo countdown is not tied to the section's 30 s `now`. No CSS added: the bar reuses mind__row and typo classes; no motion.
notes: Lint and full desktop test reds are sibling desktop-playbooks-panel/B only: src/modules/playbooks/runs.test.ts (2 unused-var lint errors; case 7 guard failing) and src/scenes/chores/topic.test.tsx case 8. An app quit (not a section close) inside the 6 s window drops the staged batch; the proposals stay open (ADR 0219 consequences).
